battle_hud.description: The ESlateVisibility of the battle HUD's party panel (Status_C, the widget party_gauges reads): 1 (Collapsed) in the field, and expected to be a shown value (0 Visible, 3 HitTestInvisible or 4 SelfHitTestInvisible) while a battle is on. Read it as "in battle" when it is neither 1 nor 2 (Hidden). Unlike the enemy bars it does not outlast the fight. The field value is confirmed; the battle value is not captured yet.

characters.description: One record per character, always nine. The first five are Cloud, Barret, Tifa, Aerith and Red XIII; the order of the other four is not mapped yet. party holds indices into this list. At the title screen, before a save is loaded, every record reads level 1 with hp_max 0.

enemy_bars.description: The pool of sixteen enemy status bars on the battle HUD, in a fixed pool order. visibility is the widget's ESlateVisibility: 0 for the bar on screen (the locked-on enemy), 1 for a collapsed one. name is the enemy's display name as the bar shows it (e.g. "Orco A"); a bar that was never used reads "" and a collapsed one may keep the name it last showed, so pick the element whose visibility is 0. After a battle the last bar shown can keep visibility 0, with the HP and stagger it had, until the next battle: use battle_hud to tell a battle from the field.

game_pause.description: EndGameState.GamePause: non-zero while the game is paused (the system menu, including mid-battle).

game_state.description: EndGameState.GameState, the EGameState enum: 0 NONE, 1 BOOT, 4 TITLE, 5 INIT_PERSISTENT, 6 GAME_IDLE, 7 PAUSE_IDLE, 8 MENU_IDLE, 9 UNINIT_PERSISTENT, 10 PAUSE_IDLE_STARTCHAPTER. Seen in practice: 6 at the title screen and in play, 8 with the system menu open, battle included. It does not tell the title screen from play; there every characters record reads level 1 with hp_max 0, gil reads 2000 and play_time_s keeps running.

gil.description: Gil. null if no gil entry is among the first 64 inventory slots. Reads 2000 at the title screen.

location.description: EndGameState.ActiveLocation, the level the game is in, as an Unreal name: "0005-TITLB" at the title screen, "0001-WORLD" anywhere in the open world, a field level's own name (e.g. "1230-MYTHM") elsewhere. It is an identifier, not display text, and does not change between the regions and places of the open world: those come from player.

party.description: The active party, leader first: three indices into characters, 16 for an empty slot.

party_gauges.description: The battle HUD gauges of the three active-party slots, in party order. atb runs from 0 to atb_max (3000), two segments of 1500 each; limit runs from 0 to 1. Outside battle they hold whatever the HUD last showed.

play_time_s.description: Play time in seconds, as the save and the main menu show it (they print it as hours:minutes:seconds). It also runs at the title screen.

player.description: The position of the pawn the player controls, in Unreal world units (centimetres): the root component's location, x and y across the map and z up. The game names the region and the place the player is in (the save screen's "Prateria / Fattoria di Oliver") from the location volume this point is inside; it keeps no value for either.

target_hp_pct.description: HP of the locked-on enemy, 0 to 100, as the HUD bar shows it (the game shows no number). null when no enemy bar is on screen. After a battle the bar this reads can keep visibility 0, with the HP and stagger it had, until the next battle: use battle_hud to tell a battle from the field.

target_stagger_pct.description: Stagger gauge of the locked-on enemy, 0 to 100. null when no enemy bar is on screen. After a battle the bar this reads can keep visibility 0, with the HP and stagger it had, until the next battle: use battle_hud to tell a battle from the field.
